messages:
sam: Pager: billing-alerts triggered for eu-prod. Multiple overage flags and delayed usage windows. tagging @mike-oncall @linh for on-call handoff. anyone seeing obvious upstream changes? :triage:
incbot: on-call notification sent to mike-oncall. incident id: INC-5998. paging schedule: eu-rotation.
mike-oncall: on it. joining. can someone dump a quick sample of the counts/sources?
linh: pulling telemetry now. consumer lag on kafka-meters-eu-2 is high, and emitter-retry counts spiked ~02:10->02:35 UTC.
linh: quick stats:
```
window_start: 2026-03-20T02:05Z
tokens_emitted/min: baseline 12k -> observed 94k
emitter_retries/sec: 0.2 -> 18
kafka_consumer_lag: 12k -> 210k
```
priya-billing: noticing UI overage banners for ~8 customers (internal ids). These look provisional but cause CS tickets. recommend we suppress customer-facing overage notifications until we confirm reconciled totals.
ops: confirming deploys: no billing service deploys in last 6h. infra autoscale for consumers kicked in around 02:20.
mike-oncall: plan: 1) pause usage->notification pipeline (emit -> notify) for eu region 2) enable emitter fallback (stateless emitter) 3) start replay/reconcile job for 02:00-03:00 window. executing step 1 now.
ops: mike-oncall, runbook command to pause notifications: `POST /ops/actions/pause-notify?svc=billing&region=eu&reason=incident-5998`  — grant applied.
mike-oncall: done. notifications paused. :white_check_mark:
priya-billing: thanks. I'll put a hold on auto-overage emails and mark affected accounts to not bill until reconciliation completes. creating JIRA INF-5998-recon.
olivia-cs: drafting a short message for impacted customers: "We're investigating transient metering inconsistencies affecting some EU customers. No final charges will be applied while we reconcile. We'll update within 2 hours." Holding until we confirm.
linh: emitter fallback enabled (stateless-emitter-v2). retries dropped, consumer lag trending down. current lag 42k and tokens_emitted/min back to ~18k.
mike-oncall: started reconciliation job: `reconcile --src=kafka-meters-eu-2 --window=02:00-03:00 --dedupe=true --out=staging-recon` . ETA ~25m.
sam: any customer-visible impact besides banners? billing spikes that could trigger ratecaps?
priya-billing: some accounts may have provisional ratecap triggers — we should suppress billing flagging and avoid automatic throttles. ops, can we disable auto-ratecap enforcement for this window?
ops: can toggle enforcement flag per region. doing it now -> `featureflags.toggle(ratecap_enforce, eu, false)`.
ops: toggled. note: this allows higher traffic but we believe it's safe short-term for mitigation.
mike-oncall: reconciliation job has processed ~60% of messages, no duplicate amplification found so far — majority of the spike looks like delayed backlog emission plus retries. moving to mitigate replay cause (tune consumer batch size).
linh: changed consumer batch_size from 500 -> 200. retries down to normal. kafka lag trending to single digits.
priya-billing: reconciliation output sample shows corrected token counts for impacted accounts (replay duplicates <0.5% of totals). Preparing rollback of suppressions after final verify.
olivia-cs: will send a hold message to customers now (soft notify): "We've paused overage notifications while we reconcile; no action needed from you." will include JIRA link.
sam: can we mark this incident as low-customer-impact after current findings? we still want postmortem and a ticket for durable mitigations (consumer backpressure controls).
mike-oncall: agree. current status: mitigated (notifications paused, fallback emitter live, ratecap enforcement disabled, reconciliation running). I'll escalate to next-level followups: INF-5998 (recon), INF-5999 (long-term emitter retry fix), INF-6000 (customer billing review).
incbot: incident INC-5998 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev3, owners=[mike-oncall, priya-billing], runbook=meters-reconcile.
sam: thanks all. after recon completes, priya please coordinate billing rollback and credits if needed. olivia, send customer update. mike, add a note on tactical steps and follow ups to the incident doc.
priya-billing: will verify reconciled reports and prepare credit recommendations if any customers were incorrectly flagged. expected by 03:30Z.
mike-oncall: leaving handoff note for next oncall; tagging @mike-oncall (self) as primary for clean up. handoff to next oncall at 03:45Z if all green.
olivia-cs: sent customer hold note. will follow up post-recon with final message.
sam: closing chat for now — please post final summary in incident channel and link to JIRA tickets.
